fusions.name: Swooping Snatch
fusions.desc: A snatch made on the wing that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Stoop from the Canopy
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. You dive up to 7 tiles onto it for 22 damage and leave it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Glide Hop
fusions.desc: A gliding hop that carries you 4 tiles forward. You move 15% faster for 2 seconds after using it.

fusions.name: Featherweight
fusions.desc: You move 12% faster at all times.
